sections.title: Scope of Services
sections.text:
Status: available

Dr. Bach schedules cataract exams, including cataract evaluations, and cataract surgery at Hollywood.

Hollywood schedules medical eye care and routine vision. Medical appointments cover current eye problems, symptoms, conditions, and ophthalmology care. Routine-vision appointments cover routine eye exams, eyeglass prescriptions, contact lens fittings, and insertion training when there is no active eye problem.

Routine-vision age minimums follow the scheduler provider rules: Dr. Kyler Farnan sees routine-vision patients age 5 and older, Dr. Lisbet Vidal sees routine-vision patients age 7 and older, and Dr. Gisselle Calero sees routine-vision patients age 4 and older. Patients below the routine-vision providers' age minimums use pediatric ophthalmology with Dr. Bach.

Hollywood does not perform retina surgical care. Retina surgical care requires a retina surgeon; the primary care provider or insurance company can provide a referral when the patient does not have one.

sections.title: Optical and Glasses
sections.text:
Status: available

Hollywood stocks many major frame brands, including Ray-Ban, Nike, Gucci, Chloe, Montblanc, Puma, Cartier, Lindberg, Mykita, and YSL.

Lens upgrades and treatments are available. The office offers all types of lenses, including upgrades and treatments.

Eyeglass prescriptions are valid for up to 2 years, but a yearly eye exam is recommended to make sure the prescription is current.

If a patient wants glasses and already has a prescription, they can bring the prescription from their optometrist and choose from the office's frame selection. Patients needing a prescription can obtain one through an optometrist appointment.

Glasses are usually ready in less than 10 business days.

Non-prescription sunglasses are available for purchase. If the patient wears prescription glasses, the office can customize prescription lenses into those frames. Most vision insurance plans do not cover non-prescription sunglasses. Sunglass brands include Maui Jim, Costa, Ray-Ban, Gucci, and many more.

Katie is the licensed optician. She has over 5 years of eyecare experience and specializes in frames, lenses, and fittings.

No appointment is needed to look at glasses or have current glasses adjusted. Sasha and Denise are in the office Monday–Thursday 8:30 AM–4:30 PM and Friday 8:30 AM–2:30 PM.

Glasses pickup policy: a readiness text confirms glasses are ready for pickup; patients wait for that text before coming in. This policy does not establish an individual order's readiness.

sections.title: Contact Lenses
sections.text:
Status: available

If a patient wants contact lenses and already has a prescription, they can bring the prescription from their optometrist.

If this is the patient's first set of contact lenses, the exam and insertion training take longer than a standard visit. First-time contact lens appointments must be scheduled before 3:00 PM Monday–Thursday and before 1:00 PM on Friday.

sections.title: Repairs and Warranty
sections.text:
Status: available

Katie can complete minor repairs in the office at no cost when possible. No appointment is needed to have current glasses adjusted.

sections.title: Insurance and Referrals
sections.text:
Status: available

For routine-vision patients, some insurances do not cover retinal photos and there is a $39 charge.

Retina surgical care needs referral to a retina surgeon. A primary care provider or insurance company can provide an appropriate referral when the patient does not have a retina surgeon.
